title: Proposal for MediSave Contribution Requirements to be Lowered Temporarily to Allow Self-employed Persons to Qualify for Workfare Income Supplement
what_it_is: Proposal for MediSave Contribution Requirements to be Lowered Temporarily to Allow Self-employed Persons to Qualify for Workfare Income Supplement

sections.label: Workfare payouts for SEPs
sections.summary: Eligible SEPs receive up to $2,667 yearly in Workfare payouts, and lower-wage employees and SEPs must contribute to CPF to benefit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Eligible SEPs receive up to $2,667 in Workfare payouts a year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: All lower-wage employees and SEPs are required to contribute to the Central Provident Fund (CPF) to benefit from Workfare.

sections.label: SEP MediSave contributions and Workfare
sections.summary: Nine in 10 qualifying SEPs met MediSave contributions for Work Year 2018, while 2019 and 2020 data are incomplete; CPF Board offers flexibility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Based on latest available data, among SEPs who met all other Workfare criteria for Work Year 2018, nine in 10 fulfilled the required MediSave contributions and received their Workfare payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Complete data on WIS SEP recipients for Work Year 2019 and 2020 are not available, as SEPs have up till 31 December 2021 and 31 December 2022, respectively to make their required MediSave contributions to receive Workfare.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: SEPs can either pay as a lump-sum or via monthly GIRO instalments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: CPF Board also exercises flexibility to help SEPs who are facing financial difficulties, such as reducing monthly instalments by extending the GIRO arrangement, or temporarily deferring monthly instalments.

sections.label: COVID-19 Recovery Grant for SEPs
sections.summary: SEPs facing significant income loss and needing urgent financial assistance may apply for MSF's COVID-19 Recovery Grant or Temporary grant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: SEPs who are facing significant income loss and require urgent financial assistance may apply for MSF's COVID-19 Recovery Grant (CRG) or COVID-19 Recovery Grant – Temporary .

sections.label: CPF contribution rates comparison
sections.summary: Most employees pay about 20% CPF contributions, while SEPs' payable is 10.5% on average.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For example, most employees are paying about 20% CPF contributions, while the SEPs' payable is 10.5% on average.
